parsed.post: My experiment with increasing the learning rate (combined with warmup) resulted in val_bpb 1.1124, which is worse than my previous best (1.0954). Discarding this change. I'll try reducing the learning rate slightly to find a better balance between stability and convergence speed.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 while keeping WARMUP_RATIO at 0.05 to see if the previous attempt diverged due to excessive learning rate.
